Company Description Rani Food Industries Limited is a growing food manufacturing and distribution company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The organization focuses on delivering quality food products to a wide range of customers through a strong and reliable distribution network. Team members work in a fast-paced environment that values accuracy, safety, and timely delivery. The company offers opportunities to develop practical skills in logistics, warehousing, and customer service within the food industry.

This role supports daily distribution operations, including receiving, storing, and dispatching products to ensure timely and accurate delivery to customers and outlets. Responsibilities include assisting with loading and unloading goods, organizing stock in the warehouse, maintaining inventory records, and following safety and handling procedures. The Distribution Assistant collaborates with distribution team members and drivers, communicates with internal stakeholders about order status, and helps resolve basic delivery or stock issues. The role may also involve operating material handling equipment as needed and supporting continuous improvements in efficiency and accuracy in the distribution process.
 Qualifications

 Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to work effectively with team members, drivers, and internal stakeholders. Candidates should possess Distribution and Inventory Control skills to assist with warehousing, order preparation, stock handling, and record keeping. Candidates should possess Forklift Operation or other material handling equipment skills, with a focus on safe loading, unloading, and movement of goods. Candidates should demonstrate basic math and documentation skills for counting, labeling, and tracking inventory. Candidates should have the ability to perform physical tasks, follow safety guidelines, and work in a fast-paced warehouse or distribution environment. Prior experience in distribution, warehousing, or logistics is beneficial; a high school diploma or equivalent is preferred.

 A global leader in innovative and sustainable building materials and solutions, Holcim is active in four business segments – Cement, Aggregates, Ready-Mix Concrete and Solutions & Products . Holcim employs ~70,000 people in 70 countries across the globe.

 ABOUT LAFARGEHOLCIM BANGLADESH PLC. 

 LafargeHolcim Bangladesh operates the only integrated cement plant in Bangladesh . It is the only cement company that has access to key raw material resource (limestone) required for the manufacturing of clinker. Limestone is transferred via unique 17km long international cross border single conveyer belt that is an engineering marvel in itself. It also has world class grinding stations located at Dhaka and Mongla that produce cement of the finest quality.

 LafargeHolcim Bangladesh is the largest listed cement player in Bangladesh with market capitalization of ~USD 1.0bn ( as on 29th Mar 2022) . It offers broad range of products and is continuously innovating to offer customized solutions to the construction market in Bangladesh.

 LafargeHolcim Bangladesh sells cement under two premium brands: Supercrete and Holcim Strong Structure . It also offers value added solutions customized for the Bangladesh market by leveraging Holcim‘s Smart Blend Technology: Holcim Water Protect (addresses key problems of water seepage, dampness and water ingress that are of significant concern for home builders) and Holcim Shokti (Bangladesh’s first Rapid High Early Strength cement). It has a wide network of 500+ distributors and 7,000+ retailers that help it to distribute its products across the country. It also has its own e-commerce website (Nirman Bandhob: https://www.nirmanbandhob.com/) through which customers can buy cement, aggregates and other products directly from the company.

 LafargeHolcim Bangladesh is also the only integrated aggregates manufacturer in the country and supplies high quality aggregates to real estate developers, ready mix concrete manufacturers and infrastructure projects. LafargeHolcim Bangladesh is the only professional waste management and disposal company in Bangladesh. Geocycle Bangladesh sources and disposes significant amount of waste which contributes to sustainability, prevents it from ending up in landfills and prevents environmental pollution.

 LafargeHolcim Bangladesh employs ~650 full time employees and provides direct or indirect employment opportunities to over 3,000 people.

 - Monitoring and coordinating daily inbound logistics operational activities.

 - Maintaining, organizing, and properly filing all relevant operational documents and records.

 - Updating and maintaining manual registers on a regular basis.

 - Regularly updating Google Sheets to ensure accurate and up-to-date operational data.

 - Supervising inbound material receiving activities and coordinating with relevant plant and departmental teams.

 - Ensuring proper documentation, recordkeeping, and timely reporting of daily operational activities.
